answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted peer attestation. Each agent locks a refundable deposit before it can vouch for others, and its endorsements carry weight only in proportion to its own earned reputation. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity and build its standing slowly, like waiting for a comet to return, while honest agents emit a steady signal of verified work. Fake accounts cluster: their endorsements form a narrow plume of mutual praise with no outside links, so the network discounts the cluster at once, and forging many credible identities costs more than it can repay.
